en.question: If, while there are no "Melodious" monsters on my field, <<11793>> and a "Melodious" monster are Special Summoned at the same time due to a Pendulum Summon, can the『If this card is Special Summoned while you control a "Melodious" monster: You can add 1 "<<4837>>" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand』effect of <<11793>> be activated?
en.title: If <<11793>> and a "Melodious" monster are Special Summoned at the same time while there are no "Melodious" monsters on my field, can that effect be activated?
